inputs.text: Tens of thousands marched through central London under an “anti-far-right” banner, backed by trade unions, anti-racism groups and Muslim representative bodies. With local elections approaching, this looks like a political effort to stigmatise ordinary concerns about national identity, social order and cultural continuity rather than answer them. A healthy society does not protect itself by telling voters which questions they may ask. It faces those questions openly and trusts citizens to debate their country’s future.

subtopics: National identity, social order and cultural continuity
